release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.24

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

Dropping a page or a document onto a document name asks whether to add it at the beginning or at the end. Cancel leaves both documents as they are. Dropping onto a page still places the item before or after that page. Pages dropped onto another document still ask Move or Copy. A document dropped onto another document is nested as a copy, and the original stays where it is.
